description: node:test conformance tests that check an implementation's exported types at compile time and its serialization at run time.

supports.description: The module named by the component's typescript implementation exports one PascalCase type per Loom type and a codecs object keyed by type id with parse(json: unknown): T and serialize(value: T): unknown; a referenced type is exported by the same module.

string, date, datetime, uuid and decimal to string (a decimal is its exact decimal text); integer and number to number; boolean to boolean; enum to a union of its string literals; ref to the referenced exported type; array to Array<T>; nullable adds | null, optional adds ?, immutable adds readonly.
Compile-time equality of each exported type with the declared shape, including keys, optionality, readonly members and member types, and of each codec's parse result with its type.
Round trip of contract-conforming payloads through parse and serialize, rejection of a payload missing a required member, and rejection of an enum value outside the set under the reject policy.
The generated test imports the module by name only; qualification maps the name to the implementation at run time.

unsupported.reason: Routines are qualified by the SQL and PowerShell profiles.

tooling.purpose: Compiles the generated tests against the implementation's declarations.
Runs the generated tests with the node:test runner.

proofLimits: The tests check exported shape and serialization only; business behavior is never generated or asserted.
Type equality is checked by the compiler; values outside the generated samples are not exercised.

checks.claim: The generated tests compile against the implementation module's declarations.
The generated node:test tests pass against the conforming implementation fixture and fail against the violating fixture.
checks.limits: Exported shape and serialization subset only.
